properties.name: chroma.initial-topics
properties.description: Comma-separated list of topics pre-loaded into the RAG system.

properties.name: chroma.base-url
properties.description: ChromaDB base URL.

properties.name: chroma.tenant-id
properties.description: ChromaDB tenant ID.

properties.name: chroma.database
properties.description: ChromaDB database name.

properties.name: chroma.collection
properties.description: ChromaDB collection name.

properties.name: chroma.distance-threshold
properties.description: Maximum distance for a ChromaDB result to be considered relevant.

properties.name: locate.chroma.collection
properties.description: ChromaDB collection ID used for page-level PDF locate index.

properties.name: locate.pdf.base-url
properties.description: Base URL prefix (file server address) the /locate endpoint prepends to a PDF's file name.

properties.name: locate.distance-threshold
properties.description: Maximum distance for a /locate result to be considered relevant.

properties.name: locate.max-results
properties.description: Number of nearest chunks to fetch from Chroma per /locate query.

properties.name: security.api-key.chroma
properties.description: Required X-API-Key value for endpoints that go through Chroma (/rag/*, /locate/*).

properties.name: security.api-key.admin
properties.description: Required X-API-Key value for all other endpoints.

properties.name: chroma.timeout-seconds
properties.description: Timeout (seconds) for Chroma HTTP calls (add/delete/query).

properties.name: app.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated list of origins allowed by CORS for the frontend.

properties.name: ocr.tessdata-path
properties.description: Filesystem path to the Tesseract-OCR tessdata folder, used for image (jpg/png) OCR.

properties.name: ocr.language
properties.description: Tesseract-OCR language code.

properties.name: external-api.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of the external document source API used by /sync.

properties.name: external-api.api-key
properties.description: API key sent to the external document source API.

properties.name: external-api.initial-since
properties.description: Default 'since' cursor used when a /sync/run is started without an explicit since value.

properties.name: external-api.page-size
properties.description: Page size (max 100) used when paging through /documents/changes.

properties.name: external-api.request-timeout-seconds
properties.description: Timeout (seconds) for the /documents/changes call.

properties.name: external-api.download-timeout-seconds
properties.description: Timeout (seconds) for downloading a file from the CDN.

properties.name: spring.ai.ollama.embedding.timeout-seconds
properties.description: Timeout (seconds) for Ollama embedding calls.
